sentences.text: Notice be made returnable within 6 weeks.
Also heard on I.A. No.1/2025-application for grant of interim relief.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that complaint filed by the respondent is barred by limitation under Section 77 of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (henceforth "the Act,
2006").
He further submits that perusal of order sheets dated from 06.04.2018 to 09.11.2023 of the trial Court would show that complainant was not aware as to the name of the accused.
Considering the backdrop, application for interim relief may kindly be allowed.

On perusal of record, this Court finds that complainant has filed a complaint case against the petitioners under Section 26(1), 26(2)(ii), 26(2)(v), 27(3)(c), 27(2)(c) and Section 31 of the Act,
2006.
It is also found that complaint case has been filed on 06.04.2018.
However, name of the owner/proprietor of Seeta Enterprises has not been mentioned and complainant sought time to file correct name of owner/proprietor of Seeta Enterprises.

On these dates which amount to nearly 5 years, complainant has not provided the name of owner/proprietor of Seeta Enterprises, therefore, learned trial Court has not taken cognizance within a period of 5 years.
On 09.11.2023, learned trial court has taken cognizance.
Under Section 77 of the Act, 2006, wherein, one year is prescribed for taking cognizance--against the petitioners after name of concerned owner/proprietor was provided by the complainant.

In the case at hand, the trial Court has taken cognizance after five years of complaint, therefore,
looking to the peculiar circumstances and complexity of the case, purely as an interim measure, it is directed that further proceedings of the trial Court in Criminal Case No.2064/2023 shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
List this matter after service upon respondent is complete.

Sd/-
